name: Lumina Shallows
description: A peaceful, glass-like wetland dotted with glowing lily pads and low-lying silt islands.

name: Whispering Meadows
description: Gentle rolling pastel plains filled with soft winds and swaying crystalline wildflowers.

name: Ashen Dunes
description: Undulating desert sands strewn with ancient low-poly obsidian ruins and warm dust devils.

name: Sunken Shroomwood
description: A moderately hilly ancient forest canopy dominated by giant bioluminescent mushrooms and mossy knolls.

name: Crystal Steppes
description: Tiered terraced plateaus encrusted with sharp, shimmering quartz clusters and steep grassy drop-offs.

name: Shattered Highlands
description: Craggy basalt hills and fractured earth bridges straddling deep misty chasms.

name: Frostfang Ridge
description: Perilously steep icy peaks and jagged glacier walls carved by relentless blizzard winds.

name: Voidreach Spirelands
description: Surreal, razor-sharp rock pillars that pierce the sky amidst floating low-poly monoliths.
